business_problem: Finastra wanted to improve its marketing processes, with campaign creation often taking up to several months.
solution_summary: Finastra used Microsoft Copilot, Power BI, Power Platform to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. It sought to streamline workflows, automate tasks, enhance analytics, and manage data crucial for boosting productivity and efficiency. The architecture emphasizes managed services, reusable integrations, and governed data handling so the organization can scale adoption without rebuilding the solution for each new team or use case.

solution_components.role: Provides generative assistance inside end-user productivity workflows.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Viva Engage
solution_components.role: Hosts collaboration and knowledge-sharing experiences for end users.
